specification.impact: Minor: additive owner-instance diagnostics and clarified shared-state/recovery contract

owner_contract.enforcement: nonblocking OS lock on stable owner.lock inode
owner_contract.owner_id: canonical UUIDv4 per coordinator acquisition; retained for nested shared-coordinator contexts
owner_contract.machine_label: hostname in execution environment, not globally unique physical-machine identity
owner_contract.contention: CONFLICT409 with bounded validated owner metadata and explicit endpoint guidance
owner_contract.lock_failure: UNAVAILABLE503 with failed operation and errno; no unlocked writes
owner_contract.direct_recovery: Before catalog persistence or admission, refuse retained nonterminal/queued Runs, unresolved attempts or index reconciliation; explicit service reconciliation/drain required
owner_contract.service_recovery: Only after all uncertain attempts reconcile successfully, clear run recovery holds; preserve terminal outcomes and queued history, retaining flags when confirmation fails.

covered: real subprocess local/service contention before control/index mutation
actual host/container bind mount at different absolute paths and PID namespaces
stable inode and fresh owner UUID after clean release and abrupt owner death
legacy, malformed, invalid UTF-8, unsupported schema and oversized diagnostic contents
nonsecret owner whitelist and credential-free endpoints
symlink/directory/FIFO lock refusal and unsupported/I/O failures
shared-coordinator nested and simultaneous thread contexts
live API owner versus direct CLI and inverse service-startup refusal
direct admission blocked after owner death with unconfirmed retained attempt
fresh/terminal histories remain eligible for direct execution
confirmed service recovery clears terminal Run holds while preserving outcomes/error/finished_at
unreachable daemon/unconfirmed stop and partial recovery preserve Run hold until successful retry
actual Docker service worker execution, official KFP client and service restart
validation.sandbox_note: An initial API TestClient run stalled under restricted socket/thread facilities and was terminated only in disposable test state; the elevated local regression run completed successfully.

limitations: Qualified actual OS locking on native Linux x86-64/Python3.13 and one Linux Docker bind mount; native Windows/macOS and Python3.12 were not rerun in this refinement.
No distributed lease/fencing or arbitrary network-filesystem SQLite sharing guarantee.
Deleting/replacing a live lock inode or non-cooperating direct SQLite writes are outside the supported contract.
No migration/combination of existing independent project histories; fresh configurations must select consistent identity, storage, recorded paths and permissions.
Existing S3 reference Compose remains unchanged; repository-backed filesystem serving is a supported configuration requiring appropriate mounts/service dependencies.
No release or complete cross-platform qualification is claimed.
